title: Normalize LDA targets to X through integer encoding
answers: LDA fit fails when X and y use different devices
Can LinearDiscriminantAnalysis accept string labels with array API features?
How should LDA handle targets from another array namespace?
body:
Symptom: LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit raises when labels use a different namespace or device from the features, including string labels.
Root cause: sklearn/discriminant_analysis.py:LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit performed X-namespace target operations without first normalizing y; raw strings cannot be represented by array API namespaces.
Fix pattern: Derive classes_ from the original y, encode y against those classes, then move the integer codes to X's namespace and device before estimating priors and invoking solvers.
Constraints: This normalization applies to computational target codes; it does not require transferring original labels. Preserve the original-label classes_ mapping, and do not attempt to transfer raw string labels into an array API namespace.
applies: Target preparation in LinearDiscriminantAnalysis.fit, especially mixed namespace/device inputs and string labels.
